metadata.name: supabase.storage
metadata.description: (state, op, project, payload) - Supabase Storage (buckets) — the cloud twin of the file-store/OPFS library, over gated fetch with the session JWT (RLS-scoped). op=upload {bucket, path, content, contentType?='text/plain', upsert?=true} → { Key }; op=download {bucket, path} → text; op=list {bucket, prefix?, limit?, offset?} → objects; op=remove {bucket, path} → ok; op=createBucket {bucket, public?} → bucket; op=listBuckets → buckets. Reads config cels sb.<project>.url / sb.<project>.anonkey. Returns a parenthesised error string on failure.
